latest_release.name: 0.3.3 - Phone Harness MCP, OpenClaw Integration, Discord, and more!
latest_release.body: ## Highlights ### **[NEW] Phone Harness MCP 🔌** > *The new [phone-harness/mcp](https://github.com/phone-harness/mcp) connects any MCP client to real iPhones and Androids!* ### **[OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) integration:** > *OpenClaw agents can now drive your iPhone, Android or cloud phone through phone-harness.* ### **phone-harness GitHub org!** > *The repo moved to [phone-harness/phone-harness](https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness).* ### Other Cool Stuff - **[REALLY COOL!!!]** The official [phone-harness discord server](https://discord.gg/7FwGsjvjS) is now live! I'd love to talk and build with you guys! - **Send files and links to your iPhone:** new `push_file` and `open_url` helpers put a file on the iPhone or open a URL on it directly. - **Smarter setup:** agents check what your machine can run and pick a phone that works, falling back to a cloud phone when there's no Mac or local device. - **Android rotation fix:** taps and screenshots now line up correctly when the screen is rotated. ## What's Changed * Do not send telemetry from CI runs by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/127 * Send telemetry from other CI runs again by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/128 * Docs: cloud iPhones don't bill by the minute by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/137 * Setup from first principles: check the environment, fall back to the cloud by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/138 * push_file and open_url: files to a cloud iPhone by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/139 * README: the hosted MCP server by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/148 * README: new header, shorter sections by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/150 * README: UTM on every site link; fix the two doc tests #150 broke by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/151 * fix(android): refresh screen bounds after rotation by @uczltw6 in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/64 * test(android): fake phone reports its screen size directly by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/153 * docs(readme): point every Cloud link at the dashboard by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/152 * telemetry: tie CLI runs to the cloud account, session and client by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/158 * telemetry: pinned scripts send their task; test_cli runs under a fresh home by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/159 * Add a catalog banner for the Hermes plugin by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/146 * docs: a cloud iPhone is a flat subscription, not "does not bill" by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/160 * Add an OpenClaw integration (PHO-90) by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/167 * PHO-58: say "start"/"use" not "rent" for cloud iPhones in the CLI by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/168 * Point links at phone-harness/phone-harness (PHO-95) by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/171 * Release 0.3.3 by @ShawnPana in https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/pull/163 * Make Hermes telemetry detection more robust (also check HERMES_REAL_HOME, honor DO_NOT_TRACK) by @ShawnPana in https://github

detail.readme:
---

--- Enable Claude Code, Codex, or any agent to use your real phone. The agent can scroll, tap, type, and read your phone with no jailbreak, no Xcode, and nothing installed on the phone. > **iPhone** through the Mac's iPhone Mirroring window
> **Android** over adb from macOS, Linux or Windows
> **Phone Harness Cloud** phone: an Android over adb, or an iPhone over HTTPS ``` ● agent: wants to open Weather │ ● find_text("Weather") → (400, 468) │ ● tap(400, 468) → reads the screen → forecast is up ✓ done ``` Try [Phone Harness Cloud](https://phone-harness.com/dashboard?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=cloud) → Hosted iPhones and Androids with stealth, real numbers, 2FA, and unlimited devices Get started by sending the [setup prompt](https://phone-harness.com?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=setup-prompt) to your coding agent. ## Demo **Task:** "Buy me a Waymo to Delah Coffee from my current location." ## Setup For the CLI, send this setup prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot, and more): ```text Install or upgrade phone-harness to the latest stable version with uv using Python 3.12, register the skill from `phone-harness skill`, then read https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/blob/main/onboarding.md and walk me through it. Follow https://github.com/phone-harness/phone-harness/blob/main/install.md if setup or connection fails. ``` The agent installs the CLI, asks which phone to use, and walks you through the steps that need your hands. What each phone needs: | Phone | Needs | | --- | --- | | **iPhone** | macOS 15+, iPhone Mirroring paired to an iOS 18+ iPhone, Accessibility and Screen Recording permission | | **Android** | adb and USB debugging, on macOS, Linux or Windows | | **Cloud Android / iPhone** | [Phone Harness Cloud](https://phone-harness.com/dashboard?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=setup-table) account; cloud Android also needs adb | `phone-harness doctor` checks the setup. Full details: [install.md](install.md) and [setup/](setup/). **MCP:** add `https://mcp.phone-harness.com/mcp` to any MCP client ([setup](https://github.com/phone-harness/mcp)). Cloud Android and iPhone only for now. **Hermes Agent:** `hermes plugins install phone-harness/phone-harness/integrations/hermes`. See [integrations/hermes](integrations/hermes/README.md). **OpenClaw:** `openclaw plugins install clawhub:phone-harness`. See [integrations/openclaw](integrations/openclaw/README.md). ## Usage ```bash phone-harness <<'PY' open_app("Notes") tap_text("New Note") type_text("hello from the harness") print([o["text"] for o in screen()][:10]) PY ``` Helpers are pre-imported; [helpers.py](src/phone_harness/helpers.py) has the full list. The agent saves its own helpers in `~/.phone-harness/agent-workspace`. ## Phone Harness Cloud No phone on your desk, or need more than one? [Phone Harness Cloud](https://phone-harness.com/dashboard?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=cloud-section) hosts them for you: - **Android phones** on demand: a fresh one per session, or a saved phone that keeps its apps and logins. - **Dedicated real iPhones**, driven over HTTPS from any OS. - **A live view** of the phone in your browser while the agent works. ```bash phone-harness cloud login # once: approve in your browser phone-harness cloud ls # phones on the account, and any live session phone-harness cloud start # cloud.phone if set, else a temporary Android; 15 min (--for 90s, 15m) phone-harness cloud start ios # the account's iPhone, when only one is listed phone-harness <<'PY' print(screenshot()) PY phone-harness cloud stop # ends the session; a saved Android is written back ``` The same helpers drive a cloud phone: an Android over adb, an iPhone over HTTPS. `cloud start` takes a phone's name or id from `cloud ls`, or `ios` / `android`; with none it starts a temporary Android. `phone-harness cloud` lists every command. ## How it works Every phone sits behind the same helpers, so a script written for one runs on the others. - **iPhone:** captures the iPhone Mirroring window, reads it with Apple's Vision OCR, and sends taps, swipes and typing as input events. - **Android:** adb for screenshots and input, the accessibility tree for text. USB or Wi-Fi. - **Cloud Android:** the same as Android, over adb to a hosted phone. - **Cloud iPhone:** ops over HTTPS. `phone-harness config set platform ios|android` picks the default phone. `phone-harness update` upgrades the CLI, and it prints one line when a new version is out (`PHONE_HARNESS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` silences it). ## Limits - Unlocking the iPhone pauses mirroring; a PIN-locked Android needs the user. - OCR sees text, not icons. Unlabeled controls need a screenshot and a vision-capable model. - No multi-touch, no camera or Face ID flows. DRM video renders black. - Connecting the phone is always the user's job. ## Sponsor phone-harness is free and maintained in my own time. [Sponsoring](https://github.com/sponsors/ShawnPana) keeps it that way.
